title: Audit event (C8)
description: One JSON object per line on a dedicated logger/appender shipped to the SIEM. Never contains argument values, tool results, secrets, confirmation codes, TOTP codes, authenticator seeds or otpauth URIs; additionalProperties is false so such fields cannot be added by accident. Target system of broker events is carried in 'server' (mcp-<system>). The serializer must escape control characters, U+2028 and U+2029 in every string value.

clientRequestId.description: X-Request-Id sent by the AI client, recorded by the gateway only (C3). Untrusted, so limited to a log-safe alphabet (CC-031); the gateway drops a value that does not match instead of rejecting the call.

backendUser.description: Account in the target system read by whoami (C4.1, CC-101), for connection_change: the only trace of which account a user connected (CC-117). Same length limit as username; C0 and C1 control characters, DEL, U+2028, U+2029 and the bidirectional controls are excluded like in resource.id. Never a secret.

id.description: Resource id as the system knows it (Jira key, GitLab path, index name, page id). Free-form because ids of the five systems use different alphabets (slashes, dots, spaces in some service desks), but C0 and C1 control characters, DEL, U+2028, U+2029 and the bidirectional controls U+202A..U+202E and U+2066..U+2069 are excluded so the line-oriented SIEM format and log viewers cannot be misled (CC-031). The length limit counts UTF-16 code units (JSON Schema validators in Java and JavaScript); producers should keep ids below 512 characters. Independently of this, the audit JSON serializer must escape every control character and U+2028/U+2029.

parent.description: Parent as <Namespace>::<Type>::<id>, e.g. Jira::Project::ABC (C8 example format).

reason.description: Machine-readable reason, snake case. Known values: policy_forbid, not_granted, tool_disabled, user_confirmed, user_confirmed_no_preview, confirmation_expired, attempts_exhausted, authenticator_not_registered, authenticator_disabled, superseded, credential_required, step_up_required, rate_limited. For event confirmation (gateway, CC-094): confirmation_pending is the decision when the pending call is created, and the outcome is one of user_confirmed (code accepted), user_confirmed_no_preview (accepted although the owner did not open the portal preview), confirmation_expired, attempts_exhausted, authenticator_not_registered, authenticator_disabled, superseded (the pending DESTRUCTIVE call was replaced by a newer one of the same user, CC-127; emitted for the older call when the newer is created, and again when the older call is retried); user_declined and preview_not_viewed are not emitted since 3.0.0 (there is no decline, and the preview is optional). For event authenticator (broker, portal, CC-094): authenticator_enrollment_started, authenticator_registered, authenticator_enrollment_failed, authenticator_removed, authenticator_reset_by_admin (outcome ok or denied; the target user is sub), authenticator_disabled (the daily limit of 20 wrong codes in 24 hours switched the authenticator off, CC-126; outcome denied) and, for the check of a code with decision allow or deny, totp_verified, totp_invalid, totp_replayed, totp_locked, totp_disabled, totp_not_registered (these carry tool, client and virtualServer from the internal JWT). For event virtual_server_change (gateway, CC-116; before 3.0.0 these were admin_change, CC-107): vs_created, vs_deleted, slug_taken, not_granted, invalid_request, virtual_server_limit, not_found_or_denied (the list of tools of a link is not a field of this schema). event admin_change is left for the other administrative changes of the gateway (registry approvals) and has no list of reasons in the contract; the vs_* reasons are not emitted with admin_change since 3.0.0. For event authentication it is the rejection code: for the internal JWT (receiver: server, broker) one of the vectors (missing_token, bad_signature, unknown_kid, alg_not_allowed, wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, replayed_jti, service_token_not_allowed, tool_mismatch, invalid_claims, lifetime_too_long, not_yet_valid, request_id_mismatch, tool_missing, tool_not_allowed, test_key_not_allowed, malformed); for the token of the AI client at the gateway (C1, CC-120): missing_token, malformed, bad_signature, unknown_kid, alg_not_allowed, wrong_issuer, wrong_audience, expired, not_yet_valid, invalid_claims, and for infrastructure failures client_certificate_rejected, jwks_unavailable, replay_store_unavailable (the last two with errorCode upstream_unavailable). The gateway also emits authentication for its own admin port (C5 /admin/v1 and /actuator/prometheus, CC-125): client_certificate_rejected for a client certificate that is missing, not from the internal CA, lacks the clientAuth purpose or has a CN that the operation does not allow, and the token reasons above for a BFF token that fails validation (aud mcp-gateway-admin). replay_store_unavailable is emitted only by receivers of the internal JWT (servers through the starter, the broker), never by the gateway. The gateway may aggregate or sample client_certificate_rejected on its admin port (for example one event per source address per minute, or a counter in its metrics) so that a scanner cannot flood the SIEM (CC-125).

argsLength.description: Length in bytes of the serialized arguments; the only trace of arguments allowed in audit.

allOf.description: Authenticator events (CC-094) always say how they ended (outcome) and why (reason). The field list stays closed through additionalProperties: there is no field that could carry a code, a seed or an otpauth URI.
Virtual server changes (CC-116) always say how they ended (outcome) and why (reason: vs_created, vs_deleted, slug_taken, not_granted, invalid_request, virtual_server_limit, not_found_or_denied).

Rejected authentication (CC-071, CC-120): emitted by a receiver of the internal JWT (server, broker) and by the gateway for the token of the AI client (C1). Closed list of fields (propertyNames): everything that comes from the claims of the unverified token (sub, username, client, tool, risk, resource, virtualServer, policyRevision, credentialType) is forbidden, and so is any part of the token. Carries the rejection code in reason.
replay_store_unavailable belongs to receivers of the internal JWT (server, broker); the gateway has no replay store for tokens of the AI client (CC-125).
